prompt.initial:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: Japanese basketball editorial thumbnail, exactly ONE complete image. Wide 16:9 horizontal canvas, ideally 2048×1152 pixels (at least 1000 pixels wide). Opaque PNG.

Create an original hand-drawn ink-and-brush sports illustration with bold readable Japanese typography. Approved visual direction: near-black #151A18 background, electric lime #CCF43B large dry-brush accents, warm ivory lettering, coarse ink outlines and hatching, sparse speckles, few elements, very strong thumbnail readability. This is NOT a photograph, NOT a photorealistic render.

Subject: exactly one REAL professional basketball player, Chase Fieler (チェイス・フィーラー). His official portrait has been visually checked on the official Koshigaya Alphas announcement https://www.koshigaya-alphas.com/news/202627s_newsigned_chasefieler . Use that verified appearance, not a fictional or generic player: tall broad athletic build, fair skin, short dark-brown hair with very close faded sides and short upright textured spikes on top, broad forehead, strong dark eyebrows, light gray-green/hazel eyes, straight prominent nose, elongated oval-to-square jaw, light short brown beard stubble all along jaw and chin and a subtle moustache, small mouth, serious focused expression. Render his distinctive face fully as illustrated ink, recognizable but never photo-like. The portrait's blue team jersey and all logos must NOT be copied.

Composition: Change from the approved example's right-side jump shooter. Put Fieler on the LEFT 43 percent, in an energetic low driving/gathering basketball motion, body leaning diagonally forward, head turned three-quarter toward the court with face clearly visible, holding one orange basketball near his hip with anatomically natural hands. His head, ball and both hands must be entirely inside the canvas; a deliberate crop at lower thigh is okay. Plain ivory and charcoal sleeveless basketball uniform, no lettering, no number, no team logo, no sponsor marks, no necklace. Exactly two arms, anatomically correct fingers, strong dynamic ink brush trails behind him. Do not add any other people, photo inserts, scoreboards, logos or official badges.
RIGHT 54 percent: large clean Japanese text blocks on clear dark space, completely separated from his face and ball. Keep a 5 percent safe inset around all text. A huge lime brush-stroke numeral 5 integrated with bold ivory ベスト can be the main hierarchy. Use the exact Japanese wording below, no player name or individual stats anywhere.

Text, verbatim and legibly typeset:
Top small: 「バスケまとめ」
Date line: 「2026.11.27｜B.ONE」
Small lime category label: 「試合前」
Medium explanatory line: 「今季平均EFFで選ぶ」
Large headline line: 「登録選手」
Largest headline line: 「ベスト5」
Readable smaller qualifier directly below headline: 「※出場確定ではありません」
Bottom footer on an uncluttered dark band: 「イラスト（AI生成）」 and 「イメージ」

Editorial ground truth is ONLY the provided fixed source.html/source.txt: this is a pregame article for November 27 with a registered-player best five based on current-season average EFF, NOT the day's completed game results and NOT confirmed participation. The player was randomly chosen from the ten equally presented named players in the article, including substitutes; he is merely the illustration subject. Do not imply he is a member of the best five, confirmed to play, scored any points, or starred in today's game. No player name, no EFF number, no player ranking, no win or score, no match-up result on the image. This is a generic conceptual playing pose, NOT reconstruction of an actual game event. The two footer labels are mandatory and must be easily readable. Do not include 成績をもとにしたイメージ because the designated annotation for this randomly selected subject is exactly イメージ. Do not carry over カルバー, 38, 仙台, 神戸, any names or any numbers from the approved style example.

Fix framing only: shrink the left-side player and ball together by approximately 12%, and shift them slightly right and down so his entire hair, head, both arms from shoulder to wrist, every visible fingertip, and the whole basketball are safely inside the canvas with at least a 3% border from top and left. generator.review_method: 生成結果を実際に目視。初稿の頭頂部・左端の指の見切れを検出し、1回だけ縮小・位置調整。修正版で見切れ解消、手指とボール保持、人物と文字の非重複、全文の読みやすさを確認。

qa_notes.text_and_numbers: 2026.11.27、B.ONE、ベスト5、今季平均EFFを固定原稿と照合。選手名・個人成績・得点・試合結果は表示していない。
